summary: Rework Core rootcause7 in place on exact parent 438bc97bfe3010ee23f150bc2f744233ba746033. Close the two controller-proven false-green routes rather than adding more labels: mandatory zero/non-draft must pass the same reviewable G1→non-persisting Admission→independent semantic review chain and consume its terminal evidence; evaluator authority must bind the exact compiled prompt actually sent plus an Agent-owned host execution/load/result record, and evidence rows must join authoritative frozen Evidence Ledger/blob/source/fact coordinates. Reject generic/unrelated response plus post-hoc matching-field stamping, summary-only/rebound evidence, missing zero admission, orphan/replayed execution, and retain correct workflow/evaluator run separation. Core contract/authority/tests only; do not implement provider runtime or edit Agent/Main.
sourceRef: Original Plan completion bullets 7-9; Requirement Design §§11.3, 11.6, 11.7, 12.2, 18.1, 18.6; controller decision evt-20260727150136-0242; Core commit 438bc97b and focused fixture false-green evidence
designIntent: 在现有 Core strict production authority 内修正 rootcause7：mandatory zero/non-draft 与 merge/duplicate 使用同一 G1→Admission→独立 review 权威链；request/execution 绑定 Agent host 实际发送的 compiled prompt、真实 load/invocation/output record 与冻结 Evidence Ledger 坐标，Main 只能机械消费，不能靠普通对象补盖字段通过。Core 不实现 provider、不建立第二 reviewer 服务。

required.verify: One clean AlembicCore commit based exactly on 438bc97bfe3010ee23f150bc2f744233ba746033; report parent, commit, tree and changed files; no AlembicAgent/Alembic source changes.

Run build:check, build, the focused disposition-review and strict semantic authority suites, full repository tests, lint/public API smoke as applicable, and git diff --check. A passing count is not evidence for the false-green negatives below.

Prove mandatory zero/non-draft has a normalized reviewable fingerprint, applicable G1, exact non-persisting Admission/corpus inspection, semantic execution, review and expression-set terminal consumption. Prove the request/execution authority carries canonical compiled prompt bytes/hash actually handed to the named Agent host adapter, exact provider/model/method/version/load/config, actual evaluator run/invocation, raw output/decision, workflow run separately, and evidence rows joined to authoritative frozen Evidence Ledger/blob/source/fact receipts.

A generic or unrelated model response followed by copying request/calibration/provider/model/load/run/prompt fields must fail even when hashes are recomputed. Reject missing zero Admission/G1/corpus inspection, caller-authored summary-only evidence, unbound/rebound evidence entry/session/subject/blob/fact coordinates, compiled-prompt mismatch, post-hoc host record, provider/model/run/invocation/output/decision mismatch, execution reuse/orphan/replay, and stale fixpoint/population/schedule/expression/target.

Core contract/authority/canonicalizer/public facade/tests only; no provider/LLM runtime, second reviewer service, Main/Agent/Plugin/Dashboard/Test/Wakeflow/vendor/cache edits; preserve legacy non-semantic V1 compatibility and accepted fact/fixpoint/finalization/CAS behavior.

Explain point-by-point why 438bc97's zero branch violated §11.6 and why its local JSON.stringify fixture plus self-hashed evidence/prompt/load coordinates could still reproduce the original post-hoc stamping false green; show how the repair closes those exact paths without claiming Core alone executed a real model.

targetTasks.summary: Repair the Core semantic disposition-review authority so zero/non-draft cannot bypass Admission and Main cannot satisfy execution provenance with self-stamped prompt/load/run/evidence fields.
